verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own filing application (coloradosos.gov/biz/FileDoc.do) lists entity formation filings for LLCs, profit and nonprofit corporations, partnerships, foreign entities, name reservations and conversions, plus a 'Tutorial - file a foreign entity.' Its business main page also lists periodic report filing and trade name renewal. Items that are paper-only are explicitly tagged '(PDF)', which implies the core formation filings are completed online. Missing for 10: explicit first-party wording that the filing and payment are completed end-to-end online, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that a filing was submitted.
